tooltip.enrichment_solution.hi_tech_gogg: Wear in head slot to inspect pipes & cables within 4 blocks.
tooltip.enrichment_solution.tank_block.t: Heats water from depth (Y), lava, magma & desert biome

tooltip.enrichment_solution.plutonium_ex: Right-click Oxidated Plutonium Ore to extract. Shift + Right-click to deposit (into offhand Isolated Backpack or inventory), or right-click onto an Isolated Backpack in inventory.
message.enrichment_solution.plutonium_ex: Extractor is already holding plutonium! Shift + Right-click to deposit.
Plutonium safely deposited into Isolated Backpack.
tooltip.enrichment_solution.distillation: Place next to an Oil Refinery (stack 1-3 high)
advancement.enrichment_solution.root.des: Craft a Machine Casing to begin your industrial journey.
advancement.enrichment_solution.enrichme: Craft an Enrichment Chamber, then feed it raw uranium and FE to produce enriched uranium.
advancement.enrichment_solution.enriched: Obtain Enriched Uranium from an Enrichment Chamber.
advancement.enrichment_solution.pcb_prin: Craft a PCB Printer to start manufacturing circuits.
advancement.enrichment_solution.first_ci: Print your first Basic Circuit in the PCB Printer.
advancement.enrichment_solution.advanced: Upgrade your production to an Advanced Circuit.
advancement.enrichment_solution.ultra_ci: Assemble an Ultra Circuit, the pinnacle of circuit technology.
advancement.enrichment_solution.oil_refi: Craft an Oil Refinery and refine crude oil into liquid isobutane.
advancement.enrichment_solution.heat_exc: Craft a Heat Exchanger to pressurize liquid isobutane using hot water.
advancement.enrichment_solution.geotherm: Craft a Geothermal Generator to turn gaseous isobutane into FE.
advancement.enrichment_solution.reactor_: Craft a Reactor Core and unlock nuclear power.
advancement.enrichment_solution.hi_tech_: Craft Hi-Tech Goggles to inspect machines within 4 blocks and read their contents.
tooltip.enrichment_solution.isolated_bac: 27-slot (3x9) lead-lined backpack. Isolates radioactive plutonium items stored inside.
message.enrichment_solution.radiation_wa: Radiation exposure! Store plutonium inside an Isolated Backpack.
tooltip.enrichment_solution.hammer_x.des: Mines a 3x3 area at Diamond Efficiency IV speed using FE. Hold Shift to mine 1x1.
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p1.b1: Enrichment Solution is an industrial tech mod powered by Forge Energy (FE), multiblock machines, geothermal cycles, and autonomous robots.
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p1.r1: Machine Casing: 4x Steel Ingot (corners) + 4x Glass (edges) + Iron Ingot (center)
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p2.b1: Steel Ore, Bauxite Ore, and Aluminium Ore generate underground (with Deepslate variants). Smelt or blast them into ingots.
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p2.b2: Raw Uranium is processed in the Enrichment Chamber to produce Enriched Uranium for high-tier energy storage.
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p2.r1: Raw Steel / Bauxite / Aluminium -> Furnace or Blast Furnace -> Ingot
guide.enrichment_solution.overview.p2.r2: Raw Uranium -> Enrichment Chamber -> Enriched Uranium
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p1.b1: Generates FE from sunlight: 60 FE/t (clear) or 15 FE/t (rain). Apply a Solar Upgrade Template to upgrade to a 2-panel Advanced Solar Panel (150 FE/t clear, 40 FE/t rain).
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p1.r1: Configurator: 3x Iron + Basic Circuit + Stick. Right-click cable/pipe arms (Auto/Push/Pull/None) or machine faces (Input/Output/None); Shift reverses.
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p1.r2: Hi-Tech Goggles: 2x Glass + Copper + 2x Advanced Circuit + 3x Iron. Inspects FE, fluids, and temperature within 4 blocks.
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p2.b1: Store FE and configure each face as Input, Output, or Disabled in the GUI or with a Configurator.
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p2.r1: Basic Cell: 4x Steel + 2x Redstone + 2x Basic Cable + Machine Casing
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p2.r2: Advanced Cell: 4x Aluminium + 2x Redstone Block + 2x Adv. Cable + Basic Cell
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p2.r3: Ultimate Cell: 4x Uranium Ingot + 2x Diamond + 2x Ult. Cable + Adv. Cell
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p2.r4: Ultra Cell: Enriched Uranium + 2x Ultra Cable + Ultimate Cell
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p3.b1: Transfer FE between generators, cells, and machines. Higher tiers increase transfer rate.
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p3.r2: Advanced Cable (x8): 8x Basic Cable around Advanced Circuit
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p3.r3: Ultimate Cable (x8): 8x Advanced Cable around Ultimate Circuit
guide.enrichment_solution.energy.p3.r4: Ultra Cable (x8): 8x Ultimate Cable around Ultra Circuit
Refines Raw Uranium into Enriched Uranium using FE (40 FE/t for 100 ticks = 4,000 FE total).
Crafting: 4x Iron (corners) + 2x Redstone (top/bottom) + 2x Steel (sides) + Uranium Ingot (center)
Enriching: 1x Raw Uranium -> 1x Enriched Uranium (40 FE/t, 5s)
Place 4 Enrichment Chambers in a 2x2 horizontal square to automatically form a Quad Enrichment Chamber multiblock.
Provides 4 parallel input/output channels running at 2x speed (50 ticks / 2.5s per item) with a shared FE buffer.
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.b1: Prints electronic circuits at 20 FE/t for 100 ticks (2,000 FE). Insert inputs, supply FE, and press Start.
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r1: Crafting: 2x Steel + Glass + 2x Aluminium + Machine Casing + 2x Redstone + Basic Cable
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r2: Basic Circuit: Redstone + Iron Ingot + Aluminium Ingot
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r3: Advanced Circuit: Gold Ingot + Aluminium Ingot + Basic Circuit
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r4: Ultimate Circuit: Diamond + Advanced Circuit + Gold Ingot
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r5: Ultra Circuit: Diamond + Ultimate Circuit + Netherite Ingot
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p1.r6: Robot Circuit: 2x Steel Ingot + 2x Aluminium Ingot + 2x Redstone
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p2.b1: Stamps metal sheets and precision robot parts at 25 FE/t for 80 ticks (2,000 FE).
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p2.r1: Crafting: 4x Steel (corners) + Piston + 2x Aluminium + Machine Casing + Basic Cable
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p2.r2: Pressed Aluminium: 1x Aluminium Ingot -> 1x Pressed Aluminium
guide.enrichment_solution.circuits.p2.r3: Mechanical Eyes: Pressed Aluminium + Glowstone Dust + Robot Circuit + Glass Pane
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p1.b1: Fluid Pump extracts Water and finite Crude Oil up to 64 blocks below.
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p1.r1: Fluid Pump: 2x Steel + Bucket + 2x Aluminium + Machine Casing + 2x Hopper + Basic Cable
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p1.b2: Oil Refinery converts 100 mB Crude Oil into 50 mB Liquid Isobutane (40 FE/t, 25 ticks).
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p1.r2: Oil Refinery: 4x Steel + Bucket + 2x Aluminium + Machine Casing + Basic Cable
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p2.b1: Connect Geothermal Tank Blocks (up to 20x20x20, 200 buckets/block) with Tank Water Input and Output ports.
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p2.b2: Heat scales with depth (Y=-50 -> 20x), Lava (3x), Magma (2.25x), and Desert biome (1.25x).
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p2.r2: Tank Water Input: Steel + 2x Hopper + Tank Block + Bucket
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p2.r3: Tank Water Output: Bucket + 2x Pressed Aluminium + Tank Block + Steel
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.b1: 1. Heat Exchanger (multiblock up to 20x20x20): Boils Liquid Isobutane into Gaseous Isobutane using Hot Water.
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.r1: Heat Exchanger: 4x Steel + 2x Copper + 2x Glass + Machine Casing
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.b2: 2. Geothermal Generator: Consumes Gaseous Isobutane (up to 50 mB/t = 1,000 FE/t at 20 FE/mB) and outputs Exhaust Gas.
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.r2: Geothermal Gen: 2x Steel + Copper + 2x Pressed Aluminium + Machine Casing + 2x Redstone + Basic Cable
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.b3: 3. Condenser: Condenses Exhaust Gas + Cooling Water back into Liquid Isobutane (1:1 closed loop).
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p3.r3: Condenser: 4x Steel + 2x Copper + 2x Blue Ice + Machine Casing
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p4.b1: Fluid Pipes move fluids. Thermal Pipes preserve hot water temperature between Tank and Heat Exchanger.
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p4.r1: Basic Fluid Pipe (x6): 6x Copper Ingot + 3x Glass
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p4.r2: Fluid Pipe Upgrades (x8): 8x previous tier around Adv / Ult / Ultra Circuit
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p4.r3: Isolated Thermal Pipe (x8): 4x Glass + 2x White Wool + 3x Basic Fluid Pipe
guide.enrichment_solution.fluids.p4.r4: Thermal Pipe Upgrades (x8): 8x previous tier around Adv / Ult / Ultra Circuit
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p1.b1: Robots are autonomous helpers with an inventory, Pickaxe & Tool slots, Follow/Stay toggle, and owner lock.
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p1.r2: Robot Casing: 4x Steel + Glass Pane + Machine Casing + 3x Aluminium
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p1.r3: Robot: 2x Steel + Mechanical Eyes + 2x Aluminium + Robot Circuit + 2x Wheel + Robot Casing
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p2.b1: Robot Charger stores 500,000 FE and charges robots on or adjacent to it at up to 5,000 FE/t.
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p2.r1: Robot Charger: 2x Aluminium + Adv. Cable + 2x Steel + Machine Casing + 3x Redstone
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p2.b2: Auto Recharger Upgrade Template lets a linked robot automatically return to its charger when low on FE.
guide.enrichment_solution.robot.p2.r2: Auto Recharger Template: 4x Aluminium + Redstone Block + 2x Diamond + Steel + Basic Cable
gui.enrichment_solution.robot.tool_confi: Place a tool to configure robot operation
tooltip.enrichment_solution.belt_drive.d: Powers adjacent Conveyor Belt lines using FE to spin the drive shaft.
tooltip.enrichment_solution.conveyor_bel: Multiblock conveyor that transports items when powered by an adjacent Belt Drive.
